#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 1000000007LL;

long long mod_pow(long long base, long long exp, long long mod) {
    long long result = 1;
    base %= mod;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % mod;
        base = (base * base) % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

class Solver {
public:
    Solver(long long p, long long k) : p(p), k(k) {}

    long long answer() {
        if (k == 0) return mod_pow(p, p - 1, MOD);
        if (k == 1) return mod_pow(p, p, MOD);
        long long ord = order();
        long long exp = (p - 1) / ord;
        return mod_pow(p, exp, MOD);
    }

private:
    long long p, k;

    long long order() {
        long long order = 1;
        long long cur = k;
        while (cur != 1) {
            cur = (cur * k) % p;
            order++;
        }
        return order;
    }
};

int main() {
    long long p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;
    Solver solver(p, k);
    cout << solver.answer() << endl;
    return 0;
}
